settings.name: decision_record
settings.description: What a typed decision keeps: the question, whose word it is, the probability and band, the evidence, the owner's ruling, and the thresholds the rulings calibrate.

entities.name: Question
entities.description: One typed question a lane must answer before it acts.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: tandt: a Digital Decision Making model, one acceptable/unacceptable element per row ranked by dominance; the first unacceptable element makes the answer no (llms-digital-decision-making.md).

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: The statement (noul), the instruction (choice, score), or the model name (tandt).

attributes.name: options
attributes.description: Choice options, Score scale, or TandT elements with their dominance.

attributes.name: subject_ref
attributes.description: What it is about: a tool call, a commit, a message, an episode, an issue.

attributes.name: criteria_ref
attributes.description: The acceptance line, chart action step or issue the answer is checked against. Without it, "is it done" was measured 83.3% unclassifiable (Miadi worker-stopped route).

entities.name: Relation
entities.description: Whose word the decision is and whom its outcome answers to (Wilson: relational accountability). Read before any probability is used.

attributes.name: word_owner
attributes.description: A named person, or 'lane' when the decision is the lane's own (the reversible tail of work already asked for).

attributes.name: accountable_to
attributes.description: The people and relations the outcome answers to.

attributes.name: does_not_authorize
attributes.description: The boundary of the authority claimed (community-choice.spec.md).

entities.name: ThresholdPolicy
entities.description: act_at and block_at for one kind of question, set by a person and recalibrated from rulings. Advisory on any decision a person owns.

attributes.name: question_class
attributes.description: The kind of question it governs, e.g. 'tool.before destructive', 'work finished against criteria'.

attributes.name: set_by
attributes.description: The person who set the thresholds. A threshold is a choice someone made, named as such (medicine-wheel#155).

attributes.name: calibrated_from
attributes.description: How many rulings the current values were checked against. Calibration holds over many decisions, never one.

entities.name: Decision
entities.description: One answer to one question in one lane: the probability, what it measures, the band, and the gate state.

attributes.name: p
attributes.description: The probability (noul), top option probability (choice) or value (score). Null when unread.

attributes.name: p_measures
attributes.description: What the number measures, in words. A number is named for what it measures, never for a value it stands in for.

attributes.name: read_status
attributes.description: unknown when the evidence was never read; it never counts as a pass (medicine-wheel infra preconditions.ts).

attributes.name: band
attributes.description: owner: the relational gate sent it to the word-owner before any threshold applied.

attributes.name: decider
attributes.description: The model and version that scored it (Jev, a local classifier, a small model).

entities.name: Evidence
entities.description: What the decision was read from: transcript lines, commits, test output, captures, a review.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.type: enum(transcript_line, commit, test_output, capture, review, issue)

attributes.name: ref
attributes.description: A path with line, a commit hash, a URL. Something a person can open.

entities.name: Ruling
entities.description: A person's answer. Their words and the agent's reading of them are two fields, and the words are never edited.

attributes.name: decided_by
attributes.description: A named person. Never a computed transition (council-record.spec.md §3.2).

attributes.name: words
attributes.description: What the person said, verbatim. Never edited.

attributes.name: reading
attributes.description: What an agent made of the words. Kept apart so a wrong reading can be corrected without touching what was said.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: spoken_transcribed carries the risk of words the transcription added (Episode staging circle, 2026-10-05).

attributes.name: verdict
attributes.type: enum(act, hold, deepen, return, defer, no)
attributes.description: Wider than pass or fail, after community-review outcomes.
